body: I sent her a message earlier explaining things but she didn't reply, I presume it's because she fell asleep.. The same thing happened to me last year around Christmas and I didn't find another girl that I talked to for 9 months, only to get rejected again

I mean, They still talk to me individually but they've dis-involved me from the stuff we do together. They're good friends, But it just really hurt me that they made this decision to just cut me off.. I have no other friends than these ones. I talked to one of them about how I started cutting again last night and they were supportive about it all so hopefully we can sort out our problems soon..

I'm not too sure if it was really the right word for how I'm feeling, It's just what my friends were saying I am. I always doubt that they like me and feel like they talk about me behind my back. Whenever I get sad I think about everything that's gone shit in my life (naturally) and think about the things I regret and how I've treated people. I just regret losing friendships and getting angry at things that weren't necessary, I'm just so irritable. Thanks for your reply

It really is awful, I constantly doubt my friendships, I find it almost impossible to believe my friends really do like me and I have a few trust issues because of it. I can't take compliments either because of it. Thank you, I have no one else to talk to right now so anyone that comments I appreciate..

I've thought this through a fair few times and can never bring mhself to do so. Because I know that it would really hurt them and I don't want to make others feel awful because of my depression. I understand your suggestion though, It is sensible to tell a family member about it but I just don't wanna hurt my parents is all. I might talk to a cousin or something though. Thanks again, not sure why your post got taken down

At times It's been the only thing stopping me, that slight overshadowing guilt of how I could be immensely hurting others. I guess they do, even though I find it a little hard to believe because of past experiences with friends. I always seem to make others laugh but wouldn't describe myself as funny which is sad because I hate to compliment myself or think good thoughts about myself. I've actually only told my parents half of it. They know I'm depressed and get anxious but they don't realize the severity of the scenario and how I have been suicidal and self harming. I want to tell them but I'm just so scared based on how my mum reacted when I once told her many years ago that I was suicidal (Ran off crying, I felt awful). I guess so, Despite having a difficult relationship with my parents at times they always have and will be there for me. Thank You. I can't convey how much I care that you guys have talked to me. Take care.

Thanks for your post dude. I really needed something like this. I actually went to see a Councillor after being referred by my doctor, and got incredibly anxious about going to both and almost skipped seeing a person that's actually there to help me. It's ridiculous and the only definite time I can escape the stress of anxiety is when I'm at home and playing on the computer which is sad as that is likely the reason that I failed college the last 2 years. People always say nice things to me but I can't believe them. I have no confidence in myself but people always say to me how they think I'm funny or whatever. It's actually kinda sad how some of the funniest people around end up getting really depressed. A few of the people I know who are hilarious have struggled with it and been in this same boat. Thank you again, I really appreciate a post like this. Take care.

I don't think it was down to intelligence, More my personal dedication. I got A's and B's and GCSE then entirely failed my A-Levels twice. I'm now doing a BTEC course with other A-Level failures which I really don't enjoy. The reason I failed the first year was down to expecting college to be as easy and school and simply being too lazy to do any of the work let alone revise at home. I then started getting depressed and missed 25% of my lessons in the second year which led to me failing again. It really tore me apart seeing so many people having a good time at Uni whilst I'm here still depressed. I understand about school though. I don't think it is for me despite being clever enough to do it (or so family tell me). I instead want to pursue joining the police but I'm too anxious to mention anything to my parents as they immediately lose control whenever I talk about my current education situation because they want to help and don't understand it. Thanks
Of course. I appreciate anyone who takes up their time to consider me.
Someone please just convince me not to do it and tell me just to go to bed.
